ThemeProps.description: Base design tokens. Every key is written to the document root as a CSS custom property named `--<key>` (e.g. `"primary-color"` -> `--primary-color`) by `applyThemeStyles` / `ConfigProvider`. Components never read these values directly from JS: their styles consume the CSS variables, so switching theme is a pure CSS-variable swap. Most semantic tokens (see `ComponentThemeProps`) are derived from these keys with `color-mix()`, so a custom theme only has to provide the base keys below.

props.name: muted-color
props.description: Muted UI color (placeholders, icons, inactive controls).

ThemeRoleTokens.description: Derived tokens for each role `R` (`--R-color-hover`, `--R-color-active`, ...). - `hover` / `active`: R mixed toward `--foreground-color` (darkens in light themes, lightens in dark themes) - `subtle`: soft tinted background (~12% R over `--surface-color`) - `border`: tinted border (~40% R over `--surface-color`) - `text`: R-toned text that stays readable on `subtle` backgrounds

TimePickerPanelProps.description: Props of the internal panel rendered by TimePicker

props.name: value
props.description: Time shown as selected (the panel's reference time when nothing is selected)

props.name: hasValue
props.description: Whether a time is actually selected (otherwise nothing is highlighted)

props.name: onTimeChange
props.description: Called when a unit is picked

props.name: value
props.description: Selected time (controlled; pair with onChange). `null` means "no time" while staying controlled; `undefined` makes the picker uncontrolled.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new time, or `undefined` when the value is cleared

props.name: use12Hours
props.description: Uses a 12-hour clock with an AM/PM column

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label of the input; without it the input is labelled "Time" (localized)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the input when no visible label is shown

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the panel opens or closes

props.name: clearable
props.description: Allows clearing the value with the suffix button

props.name: size
props.description: Size of the input and panel

props.name: minTime
props.description: Earliest selectable time; earlier options are disabled

props.name: maxTime
props.description: Latest selectable time; later options are disabled

props.name: ref
props.description: Imperative handle with open / close / toggle

props.name: children
props.description: The element that triggers the tooltip; prefer a focusable element

props.name: open
props.description: Whether the tooltip is shown (controlled; pair with onOpenChange)

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called with the requested open state (hover, focus, Escape, ref methods)

props.name: enterDelay
props.description: Delay before showing on hover, in milliseconds

props.name: leaveDelay
props.description: Delay before hiding on mouse leave, in milliseconds

props.name: offset
props.description: Offset as [x, y] in pixels. For top/bottom placements `y` is the gap to the trigger and `x` shifts along it; for left/right placements `x` is the gap and `y` shifts along it. Without it the tooltip sits 8px away.

props.name: followCursor
props.description: Makes the tooltip follow the mouse cursor

props.name: bgColor
props.description: Custom background color (CSS gradients are supported)

props.name: arrow
props.description: Shows an arrow pointing at the trigger

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name of the trigger wrapper

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Called when the tooltip opens from hover or focus

props.name: onClose
props.description: Called when the tooltip closes from mouse leave, blur or Escape

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the tooltip element

props.name: itemHeight
props.description: Fixed row height in pixels; measured from the first item when omitted

props.name: itemPadding
props.description: Padding of each row in pixels

props.name: overscan
props.description: Number of rows rendered above and below the visible area

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height of the scroll container in pixels

props.name: renderItem
props.description: Renders the content of one row

props.name: style
props.description: Inline styles of the scroll container

props.name: onLoadMore
props.description: Called when scrolling near the bottom; return a promise that resolves once new items are loaded (no new call happens until it settles)

props.name: loadMoreThreshold
props.description: Distance from the bottom (px) at which onLoadMore is triggered

props.name: highPerformance
props.description: Batches scroll updates with requestAnimationFrame and requestIdleCallback

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading indicator at the bottom of the list

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the root (scroll container) <div> element

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style of the button (reflected to the `variant` attribute)

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner instead of the content and blocks clicks; sets `aria-busy`

props.name: active
props.description: Renders the button in its pressed / active style

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label forwarded to the inner `<button>`; set it with the `aria-label` attribute. Required for icon-only buttons.

wc:ButtonVariant.description: Public attributes of `<minerva-button>`. Values mirror the classes defined in `./styles.ts`; keep both in sync.
